title: Calibrate the adapted OOD score on 160 labels + joint review/error frontier
label_source: human (labels/ood160_labels.json; 138 good / 22 bad, 47 factories, single labeller)
protocol: leave-factory-out grouped CV: calibrator fit on 46 factories, evaluated on the held-out factory; pooled OOF predictions. Factory-grouped bootstrap CI (n_boot=2000, seed=11).
adapted_scores: recomputed exactly per O4 (IndEgo-signed per-domain z-score, equal mean); O4 AUROCs reproduced to <0.005.
